name: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Limited

facts.business: SPARC is a life sciences company engaged in research and development with operations in India and the USA, focusing on biotechnology and pharmaceutical research.

auditor.name: KJB & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company had inadvertent lapse in complying with the provisions of Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, with respect to the appointment of Mr. Venkateswarlu Jasti with effect from May 19, 2025. Both NSE and BSE levied fines for the same.

key_risks: Regulatory compliance risk related to SEBI Listing Regulations
Dependence on promoter group funding through preferential warrants
No dividend payout indicating potential cash flow constraints
Lapse in corporate governance compliance resulting in stock exchange fines
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements entered by the Company during the year with the related parties were in the 'Ordinary Course of Business' and on an 'Arm's Length Basis' and in accordance with the provisions of the Act and rules made thereunder, the SEBI Listing Regulations and the Company's Policy on Related Party Transactions. Details of transactions entered with related parties under the Act are given in Form AOC-2 provided as Annexure 4.
